title: Dancing Girl's Disappearing Torso: NCERT's Self-Censorship
description: In June 2026, something unusual turned up in Madhurima, the new Class 9 Arts Education textbook that NCERT introduced under the National Education Policy. The Dancing Girl of Mohenjo-daro, a bronze figurine roughly 4,500 years old and among the most recognisable artefacts to survive the Indus Valley Civilisation, appeared in the book with her torso shaded over, giving her the appearance of being clothed.
